MACHO.definition: A male exhibiting or characterized by machismo.

MOCHA.gloss: soft suede glove leather from goatskin
MOCHA.definition: Soft suede glove leather from goatskin.

COMA.gloss: a state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness
COMA.definition: A state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness; usually the result of disease or injury.

CAMO.gloss: fabric dyed with splotches of green and brown and black and tan
CAMO.definition: Fabric dyed with splotches of green and brown and black and tan; intended to make the wearer of a garment made of this fabric hard to distinguish from the background.

MAC.gloss: a waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric
MAC.definition: A waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric.

CAM.definition: A rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion.

HAM.gloss: meat cut from the thigh of a hog
HAM.definition: Meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked).
